name: Walter the Reeve
role: Fictional reeve (Episode H02): a villein like You, chosen to run the lord's farm for a year. Not a villain: a neighbour stuck between the lord and the village.

signature.gesture: Taps his tally stick when he counts you present.

voice.notes: aru speaker 7 (~118 Hz measured); distinct from the baker (9) and narrator (3).

kokoro.notes: Kokoro bm_lewis: brisk, distinct from the narrator and the baker.
